note: The full feature list. scripts/build-features.py renders it to site/landing/site/features.html; keep it in step with CHANGELOG.md.

features.name: An artifact
features.summary: A directory with a manifest, a publishable site/ and a private work/: a piece of presentation that lives beside the research behind it, in the repo that owns the subject.

features.name: Start one
features.summary: Scaffolds the manifest, a starter page, the vendored kit and a private brief, plus working rules for agents.

features.name: Kinds and forms
features.summary: What it's about (explainer, report, walkthrough, presentation, case study, explorer, note…) is separate from how it's read: article, collection, explorer or deck.

features.name: Status
features.summary: Manifest health, what the firewall would publish, and library drift, for one artifact.

features.name: Every artifact in a repo
features.summary: Find all artifacts under a folder, and a coherence report across them.

features.name: Write in Markdown
features.summary: Article and collection pages render from Markdown into deterministic, accessible shells; delete [content] to own the HTML instead.

features.name: Images and figures
features.summary: An image on its own line becomes a figure, with its title as the caption and alt text checked.

features.name: Video loops
features.summary: A video in an image line becomes a silent, named loop with a poster, paused for readers who prefer less motion.

features.name: Toggle figures
features.summary: Two to four images or loops the reader flips between, in pure CSS.

features.name: Tables
features.summary: Pipe tables, with numeric columns and a scroll region so a wide table never widens the page.

features.name: Page front matter
features.summary: Each page can set its own description, kicker and social card image.

features.name: Blocks
features.summary: ::: callout, stats, pullquote, figure, wide, cards and lede, checked at build time and reported by line when written wrong.

features.name: Data tables from a pack
features.summary: ::: grid data=PACK draws a table from a data pack, with its columns checked against the data, so no figure is retyped.

features.name: HTML islands
features.summary: ::: html is the escape hatch: raw HTML copied verbatim, still under every check.

features.name: Diagrams
features.summary: Mermaid fences render offline as diagrams that follow the theme and re-lay themselves on narrow screens.

features.name: Named looks
features.summary: editorial, ledger, broadsheet or field: token sets that hold contrast in light and dark, so artifacts needn't all read as one product.

features.name: artoo-kit
features.summary: Article layout, figures, callouts, cards, the provenance panel and light/dark, with a documented class vocabulary.

features.name: artoo-deck
features.summary: Slides as a deck: acts, speaker notes, overview, keyboard and touch, landscape print.

features.name: artoo-grid
features.summary: Dense comparison tables with sorting, frozen columns, in-cell bars and heat, CSV export, and missing values that never read as zero.

features.name: artoo-controls
features.summary: Explorer controls: search, filters, chips, result counts, URL state, CSV, saved configurations.

features.name: artoo-diagrams
features.summary: Mermaid-syntax diagrams rendered offline by a pinned, auditable Pele build.

features.name: artoo-map
features.summary: An offline, interactive code map: focus, paths, truth layers, exports.

features.name: Vendored, pinned, offline
features.summary: Every runtime asset is copied in with a hash; nothing loads from a CDN, so an artifact opens from a file.
features.cli: lib add · vendor URL · update · status

features.name: Data packs
features.summary: One private JSON source becomes publishable JSON and a file://-safe script global.

features.name: Evidence and provenance
features.summary: Claims on the page link to their sources in a provenance panel, from any provider.

features.name: Flip notebooks
features.summary: Attach a research notebook: project its claims onto the page, and route feedback back into it.

features.name: Chart guidance
features.summary: Record a Vizier guide for the charts in an artifact.

features.name: Build
features.summary: Runs your build commands, renders the pages, packs the data, vendors what's needed, and verifies the result.

features.name: Static checks
features.summary: Links, anchors, assets, duplicate ids, alt text, remote dependencies, data JSON.

features.name: No invented classes
features.summary: A class guessed inside a library's namespace fails the build and names the nearest real one, or the library update it needs.

features.name: Browser checks
features.summary: Every page in Chromium at phone and desktop width: errors, overflow naming the element, broken images, contrast, tiny or clipped text.

features.name: Contact sheet
features.summary: Every page at desktop and phone, side by side, in one image.

features.name: Design lint
features.summary: Named rules for pages that look generated: raw colours, foreign fonts, gradient text, glass, emoji icons, stock copy.

features.name: Review against the render
features.summary: A finding or its fix, bound to exactly the files the page serves and the Git head.

features.name: Serve it locally
features.summary: Runs the artifact the way a deploy would show it: a withheld file is absent, not just unlinked.

features.name: Saved state
features.summary: Named JSON documents a page saves through serve, kept in the artifact's state/ folder, with conflict checks.

features.name: The firewall
features.summary: Only site/ publishes. Research, briefs and state sit beside it and can't ship by accident.

features.name: Deploy
features.summary: Firewall-staged, then handed to an adapter: GitHub Pages (docs, workflow or branch), rsync, or a command.

features.name: Working rules for agents
features.summary: Each artifact carries a short AGENTS.md and an on-demand ARTOO_REFERENCE.md generated from the libraries it actually vendored.

features.name: The reference, offline
features.summary: artoo docs prints the golden path, the manifest, every block and every library's vocabulary.

features.name: Install as a skill
features.summary: Installs artoo's contract as an agent skill.

features.name: llms.txt
features.summary: The whole reference for language models, published beside the site.

features.name: Generators
features.summary: Plugins that write artifacts: an explainer for a repo, and a report from a notebook.

features.name: Workers
features.summary: Tiered delegation to local agent CLIs for analysis and synthesis.

features.name: Plugins
features.summary: Generators, deploy adapters and site libraries are entry points, so others can add their own.

features.name: Code graphs
features.summary: artoo map build records a repository's structure with evidence: source coordinates, truth classes, receipts.

features.name: Ask the graph
features.summary: view, why, path and context answer bounded questions about a codebase, with the evidence behind each answer.

features.name: Exports
features.summary: Mermaid, JSON and SVG views of the same selection; Mermaid is an export, not the source of truth.
